notes.title: Bring the Heat in this Hard Rock Shooter!
notes.notes:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/593680/Rocking_Pilot/

Rocking Pilot, a twin-stick shoot ‘em up, is out now on Steam.  Rocking Pilot  is available now on PC and will be launching on PS4 at a later date. Rocking Pilot is an irreverent single player top-down shooter that combines combo high score chasing, cartoony graphics, fast-paced arcade gameplay, a heavy rock soundtrack and crazy weapons into one awesome package. 

With a punk spirit, zany characters and fast-paced arcade gameplay, Rocking Pilot is a contemporary version of the classic shoot ‘em ups of the 90s consoles and arcades!

Try this ​hell out!
